what: The 6-class predictions re-scored as the binary decisions a screening service actually makes, at both the image and the examination-session unit.

definitions.severe: stage 3, stage 4/5, or AP-ROP — the end of the ladder where treatment decisions live
definitions.why_not_type_1: ICROP-3 Type 1 is defined on zone x stage x plus. This corpus has no usable zone axis (Multi-View records zone for 13 of 232 patients; the rest record none), so Type 1 cannot be computed and is not claimed.
definitions.bias_direction: SEVERE over-includes — a stage 3 in zone III without plus is not Type 1. It is a sensitivity-oriented proxy, stated so that it is not read as Type 1 performance.

image.ci_note: the clustered interval is the one to quote; the exact interval treats correlated frames from one infant as independent evidence

severe_miss_anatomy.reading: Of 506 missed severe images, 284 were called stage 2 — a near miss a graded referral protocol still escalates — and 106 were called normal, which is the failure that matters. The ratio, not the miss count, is the clinically informative number, and it is a direct consequence of training the stage axis as an ORDINAL problem: errors land next door.
